// Integrations, grid beside the pitch: the heading and a line of copy on the left, eight integration // tiles on the right. The tiles are kinds of tool (card payments, accounting, team chat) with an icon, // not real brands; put your partners' names and logos in their place. From the Orbit landing template. import { ArrowRight, Calculator, CalendarDays, CreditCard, Landmark, Mail, MessageSquare, Sheet, Webhook } from "lucide-react" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" const INTEGRATIONS = [ { icon: CreditCard, name: "Card payments", body: "Cards and digital wallets" }, { icon: Landmark, name: "Bank transfer", body: "Local transfers in 30 currencies" }, { icon: Calculator, name: "Accounting", body: "Sync invoices and payments" }, { icon: Sheet, name: "Spreadsheets", body: "Export or live-sync to a sheet" }, { icon: Mail, name: "Email", body: "Send from your own address" }, { icon: MessageSquare, name: "Team chat", body: "A ping when an invoice is paid" }, { icon: CalendarDays, name: "Calendar", body: "Due dates on your calendar" }, { icon: Webhook, name: "Webhooks and API", body: "Build anything on top of Orbit" }, ] export default function IntegrationsGrid() { return (

The block is in components/dresscode/integrations-grid.tsx; render it in any page.
It wears your DressCode theme (its colors, fonts and corners, and the dc-* classes the theme adds). Pick one at https://dresscodeui.com/themes, e.g. npx shadcn@latest add https://dresscodeui.com/r/dresscode/mono.json
